name: Nextra
description: Nextra is a Next.js based static site generator that compiles Markdown and MDX content into App Router pages, best known for docs and blog themes.
notes: Nextra 4.6.1 on Next.js 16.3.8, App Router, output: 'export' and trailingSlash. No Nextra theme: a bare layout and MDX wrapper render only the post; the index is a plain page listing the post slugs. Search (pagefind) is off: Nextra 4 only indexes through a separate postbuild script, which is not run. firstRelease is approximate (first nextra npm release in 2020).
